5-8 (2-6 SBC): a bottom-third SBC offense (24.2 ppg, 22 turnovers / 15 INT) + a leaky defense (416.6 ypg allowed). Both 2025 QBs left (Swann->Miss St, Kohl->FIU); the offense resets around transfer QB Malachi Singleton (Purdue/Arkansas, dual-threat).

The returning STRENGTHS are three genuine pieces: LB Colton Phares (87.7, 101 tkl/3 INT - a real star), edge Aiden Benton (74.2), and RB Jaquari Lewis (73.8, 618 yds as a frosh). Nearly everything else is a transfer/FCS reload.

The DL was gutted (Abrams-Verwayne 83.2 yr4, Porter 79.2->Rutgers, Manuel->Colorado, Farrior->Auburn, Cooper->Wisconsin all gone); Benton + Sandstrom anchor a rebuild. The secondary lost '9 of the top 10 tacklers' (PS) and reloads via ACC transfers (Reddish/VT, Conley/UNC) + injury-return McBurrows.
ST: FCS All-American K James London (Murray State; 6 FGs of 50+) is a real weapon (though he left Pitt after a '25 competition); the punter (Dunn, Arkansas State) has never played a college snap.
